phrases.text_l1: أغلبية يهود لبنان عاشوا في بيروت
كم اسم وجدت في لبنان أو في بيروت؟
واحد مدفون فيها ممكن كان يزور بيروت
ودفن فيها، مش معناها انه من أعضاء
أو مثلا كان طالب في احدى الجامعات
لكن الكثير من اليهود لم يملكوا
أنا بشوف بس جزء من العائلات
أنا ما شفتش دلائل التليفونات في بيروت
وجودهم في دليل التليفون يعني أن كان لهم
تليفون أو كانوا في المهن الحرة
واحد كان رجل أعمال أو محامي أو دكتور،
طبعا يكون له تليفون في البيت
لكن اليهود البسطاء ما كانش لهم تليفون
مشكله بالنسبه لي، يعني هم مستورين
ماذا اكتشفت عن خلفية يهود لبنان
من خلال الاسماء؟ من أين أتوا؟ مناصب؟
يعني كانت لي قاعدة بيانات من الأسماء
عندي فرصة لأعرف من أين وصلوا
اكتشفت فيها الكثير من الاسماء اليهودية
وكمان من بغداد وكمان اكتشفت أشكناز،
في نهاية القرن التاسع عشر، عدد يهود

phrases.text: Most of Lebanon's Jews lived in Beirut
And efforts were made
To publish the names of Jewish families
That lived in Beirut
In the twentieth century
How many names did you find in Lebanon or in Beirut?
About 750 family names in Beirut
Retired ambassador Yaakov Rosen
But there are many problems
The archives are closed
There was a Lebanese Christian researcher,
Naji Zeidan, who passed away two years ago
He wrote a book about the Jews of Lebanon
And he documented the Jewish cemetery
In Beirut
The problem with these lists (of names)
The list of those buried in the Jewish cemetery
In Beirut
Someone buried there might have been visiting Beirut
And died there
And was buried there, doesn't mean he was a member
Of the Jewish community in Beirut
Or for example, was a student at one of the universities
In Beirut and died
But many Jews did not possess
Lebanese citizenship,
And did not participate in elections
Meaning they are not included in the lists
That were compiled by Naji Zeidan
I only see part of the families
That lived in Beirut
I haven't seen the telephone directories in Beirut
Their presence in the phone book means they had
A phone or were in liberal professions
Someone was a businessman, lawyer, or doctor,
Of course, he would have a phone at home
But ordinary Jews did not have a phone
A problem for me, meaning they are hidden
Behind the mountains...
What did you discover about the background of Lebanon's Jews
Through the names? Where did they come from? Positions?
Fortunately, the index of Jewish families
In Beirut
Is the last index I published
Before it, I published indexes for Cairo, Alexandria,
Baghdad, Damascus, and Aleppo
Meaning I had a database of names
And when I see the names of Beirut Jews
I have a chance to know where they came from
I discovered many Jewish names in it
From Damascus and from Aleppo
And also from Baghdad, and I also found Ashkenazi,
Ashkenazi names
At the end of the nineteenth century, the number of Jews
In Beirut was about 3,000 people
